name: Amara Nwosu
headline: Distributed systems architect — payments and ledger platforms at national scale
summary: I design ledgers and settlement systems that must never lose a penny. Most of my work sits where correctness, regulators and very high throughput meet.

major_impact.title: Rebuilt the settlement ledger for a national payments scheme
major_impact.summary: Replaced a nightly batch ledger with an event-sourced double-entry ledger, so settlement could run in near real time while keeping every entry auditable.

major_impact.title: Brought a fintech's platform team from 3 to 22 engineers
major_impact.summary: Set up the platform group, wrote the RFC process and on-call model, and moved services onto a shared deployment platform.

proof_of_work.title: ledger-kit — double-entry primitives for Go
proof_of_work.description: Library for idempotent, append-only accounting entries.

proof_of_work.title: Talk: Exactly-once is a lie, idempotency is not

vouches.statement: Amara owned the ledger redesign end to end. It is the most reliable system I have run.

name: Mateo Ferreira
headline: Staff platform engineer — Kubernetes, developer experience and cloud cost
summary: I build internal platforms that product teams actually want to use, and keep the cloud bill honest along the way.

major_impact.title: Internal developer platform for 300 engineers
major_impact.summary: Designed a golden-path platform on EKS with templated services, preview environments and built-in observability.
metrics: New service to production: 2 weeks → 40 minutes

proof_of_work.title: Write-up: Cutting EKS costs by a third

vouches.statement: Mateo's platform work changed how our whole engineering org ships.

name: Anjali Rao
headline: Principal ML engineer — search ranking and recommendation systems

major_impact.title: Learning-to-rank search for a 90M-user travel app
major_impact.summary: Replaced hand-tuned relevance rules with a learning-to-rank stack, plus an offline/online evaluation loop the product team could run on its own.

major_impact.title: Company-wide ML platform
major_impact.summary: Unified training, feature and serving infrastructure for eleven ML teams.

proof_of_work.title: Paper: Counterfactual evaluation for travel search

name: Liam Tremblay
headline: Security architect — zero-trust networks and identity for regulated industries

major_impact.title: Zero-trust migration for a federally regulated bank
major_impact.summary: Took 1,400 internal services off VPN-based trust and onto identity-aware proxies with short-lived workload credentials.
metrics: Passed OSFI audit with zero findings

proof_of_work.title: Talk: Zero trust without the buzzwords

vouches.statement: Liam led our zero-trust programme and left us with a team that can run it.

name: Hana Kim
headline: Engineering director — mobile and frontend platforms for consumer products

major_impact.title: Unified web and mobile design system across four product lines
major_impact.summary: Funded and led a shared component platform, so four previously separate apps now ship one consistent, accessible UI.
